about.text: A brined cow-milk brynza from the Hutsul region of the Ukrainian Carpathians, made with at least 70% cow milk and up to 30% sheep or goat milk. It is made by traditional recipes with natural rennet, a drained curd, salting and barrel storage, and it has a registered indication.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
